## Problem and change

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if any.

## Verification

Describe tests run and relevant sample output. Note any untested platforms.

## Checklist

- [ ] Formatting, linting, and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed commands or behavior.
- [ ] Added dependencies and their licenses/size effects are explained, if any.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic or safe to publish.
